messages:
Marie: Quick spike: proposing a 'Silent Ink' dark theme variation. aim is softer blacks and muted accents for long-session dashboards. want opinions on chart fills and code styling.
Priya: Nice name. Can you share the core tokens and a short why?
Marie: Core tokens: bg #0b0f12, surface #10161a, text #d6e7ef, subtext #a7bac6, accent #5ec4ff, soft-accent #89e1ff. Rationale: lower overall contrast, fewer bright whites to reduce eye fatigue.
Omar: Charts: area fills are currently 40% opacity on light themes which look like blobs on dark. Suggest gradient stops and subtle outlines.
Tasha: For syntax, I'd keep keywords cool (#b68fff) instead of orange. Cooler keywords play nicer with blue accents. Strings could be a desaturated green (#8fd59b).
Ben: Accessibility: ensure axis labels meet 4.5:1 and tooltips 3:1 against panel. Also consider a 'reduce glow' toggle for folks sensitive to bloom effects.
Marie: Draft snippet: 
```
--bg: #0b0f12
--panel: #10161a
--text: #d6e7ef
--muted: #a7bac6
--accent: #5ec4ff
--accent-soft: #89e1ff
--keyword: #b68fff (600)
--string: #8fd59b
--comment: #6f8b97 (italic)
--border: #263238
```
Priya: Love the border token. For charts: try outlines at 1px plus 12% darker line to separate layers. Area gradient from 18% -> 2% alpha.
Omar: Also we should tweak the legend swatches to use a lighter halo when selected for visibility on small monitors.
Tasha: Syntax weights: keyword 600, function 700 (semi-bold), type 650, variable 500. Keep numbers same as text but slightly brighter.
Ben: Copy nit: theme picker label currently reads 'Silent Ink (Dark)'. Consider 'Silent Ink' plus subtitle 'Gentle contrast for long sessions' as microcopy.
Marie: Hmm maybe too long in dropdown. Could show subtitle on hover or in settings page only. Dropdown keep 'Silent Ink'. Settings show the rest.
ContrastBot: Reminder: when updating tokens, run the theme diff bot to flag any contrast regressions across components.
Priya: UX question: do we expose an "edge-contrast" toggle for people who want more definition? That would apply to borders, axis weight, and focus rings only.
Omar: I prefer toggle vs separate theme. Less theme proliferation. Toggle flips border -> #1b2326 and text -> #ffffff, and bump axis stroke to 1.5px.
Tasha: I'll prototype code block rendering with these tokens and push to storybook. Want to test with long code samples and diffs.
Ben: QA plan: test 5 screen sizes, 3 monitor calibration profiles, and run 3 colorblind simulators. I'll draft checklist.
Marie: I'll upload Figma frames and link the prototype. If no objections by tomorrow morning we'll mark for engineering handoff.
Priya: +1, small tweak: tooltip copy on theme switch should read: 'Switch theme. Silent Ink reduces contrast for evening use.'
Omar: +1 to tokens, will review Storybook once Tasha pushes.
Tasha: +1, on it.
Ben: +1 from accessibility.
Marie: Thanks all, filing the PR and tagging @eng-frontend and @a11y for the rollout plan.
